method: Alternating old/new processes, serial execution; single/repeated discard sample 0 and report medians of 7 samples. Single: 1M 24-byte APP nodes, keep a chain with i%100<live_percent. Repeated: ten rounds of 200K nodes, replace root each round, 10% live, collect after each round. Build: existing bench_build 1M iterations, median of 5 post-warmup inner samples per process. Collection timing has no active mutators; mark_ns includes handshake/mark/queue, cycle_ns includes wait for concurrent sweep. Memory fields exclude allocator metadata and are not RSS. Startup, teardown and correctness traversal excluded.
